name: v3_cno_poisson
_comment: CNO Representative PDE Benchmarks (Zenodo 10406879, data.zip), PoissonData_64x64_IN.h5, first 1000 of 2048 samples stacked losslessly by bench/convert_v3.py: input = source f, output = u. -Laplace(u) = f on (0,1)^2, u = 0 on the boundary; f = sum of K = 16 sine modes with random coefficients (sign-changing), u the exact series solution sampled on a 64 x 64 grid (Raonic et al. 2023, SM C.3.1). Raw (the loader normalises with min/max constants stored in the file, not applied here). float64.
